title: .chats.json5 — project chat bindings
description: Maps a project working directory to the chat rooms/groups where discussion around that code happens (Matrix, Telegram, IRC, Slack, Discord — any subset). JSON5 files are parsed first, then validated against this schema (e.g. with ajv). telegram.topics is the forum-group discriminator: present = group with topics, absent = plain group. Every chat block is optional; a block's presence binds that channel for the project.

project.description: Project name, usually the repo directory name.

telegram.description: Telegram binding. topics present = forum/supergroup with topics; topics absent = plain group without topics.

topics.description: Forum topics of the group. Omit the key entirely for groups without topics.

id.description: message_thread_id. 1 = the implicit General topic (Telegram omits message_thread_id on General messages).

general.description: true for the implicit General topic.

irc.description: IRC binding. IRC has no global ids: a network is named (often exposed via the NETWORK= ISUPPORT 005 numeric) and you connect to a specific server host; channels are #name (case-insensitive per casemapping). Identify by network + server + channel.

network.description: Network name, e.g. 'libera' (from NETWORK= 005 numeric or convention).

server.description: Server host used to connect, e.g. 'irc.libera.chat' (optionally with :port).

slack.description: Slack binding. Slack identifies workspaces (T-prefixed team id) and conversations via conversations.list: public channels C…, private channels/groups G…, DMs D…. Ids are uppercase alphanumeric.

workspaceId.description: Team/workspace id, T-prefixed (e.g. T0B7JBCDKC1). Shown in the workspace URL app.slack.com/client/<T…>/<C…>.

channelId.description: Conversation id: C… public channel, G… private channel/group, D… DM.

discord.description: Discord binding. Discord ids are 64-bit snowflakes, ALWAYS carried as strings (uint64 overflows JS safe integers). A channel is identified by guild_id + channel id.

guildId.description: Guild (server) snowflake id as a string.

channelId.description: Channel snowflake id as a string.
